author: Sean_S

title: Great variety of food with Jordi!
text:
Really awesome experience with Jordi as our guide! We were a group of 7 with food restrictions (vegetarian, no pork, etc.) and he was able to accommodate everyone. 

There was a good variety of food from sweets, alcoholic and non alcoholic drinks, and we ended off the night with paella. 

Jordi introduced us to Barcelona food as well as the culture and background of the food, such as the xuixo donut, orxata, vermut, and assessing a restaurant's quality through their patatas bravas. Very educational!
author: 944hollyw

title: Awesome Food Tour!
text:
This was my 5th Secret Food tour, having done it in Amsterdam, Athens (best!), Austin, Las Vegas, and now, Barcelona. I booked a hotel conveniently across the street from the meeting point. 
Jordi was an exceptional guide. He showed us places to visit later as we walked through El Born (I won’t have known if not for this tour). He taught us how to order tapas. The food was delicious and too much! Unfortunately, the paella was the last item and we were so stuffed. So come hungry and I would recommend to get on a Secret Food Tour early on in the city you’re visiting.
